scripts.build:all: nest build service && nest build back-office
scripts.start:service:local: cross-env NODE_ENV=local OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=service nest start service --watch
scripts.start:back-office:local: cross-env NODE_ENV=local OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=back-office nest start back-office --watch
scripts.start:service:dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=service nest start service --watch

scripts.start:service:debug: cross-env NODE_ENV=development OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=service nest start service --debug --watch
scripts.test:e2e: node -r tsconfig-paths/register node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config ./test/service/jest-e2e.json && node -r tsconfig-paths/register node_modules/jest/bin/jest.js --config ./test/back-office/jest-e2e.json
